Argentina edges Egypt in World Cup match amid controversy

Argentina secured a 3-2 victory over Egypt in a World Cup match following a late comeback. Lionel Messi scored in the game, which saw Argentina overcome a two-goal deficit. The match has drawn controversy, with Egypt's coach alleging unfair play and FIFA favoritism, claims that have divided opinions.
